responsibility: Implements the MIR source-coverage instrumentation pass, coordinating coverage graph construction, source-span extraction, counter/expression assignment, and injection of `StatementKind::Coverage` metadata and executable counters into MIR.
same_name_distinction: This `mod.rs` is the source-coverage instrumentation pass root, coordinating coverage graph construction, span analysis, counters, and MIR injection. Its sibling `mod.rs` files under `transform` cover unrelated passes or the whole transform framework, and `coverage/tests.rs` or `graph.rs` are just support pieces for this pass.
